title: God-conscious Being Is The Dust Of All
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 272
summary: Softness is carried here from the God-conscious being is the dust of all toward o Nanak, the God-conscious being is absorbed in God's meditation.
whyItMatters: This shabad is useful when life feels hard, sharp, protective, because it keeps softness inside remembrance, conduct, and the Creator's larger care instead of private mood.
takeaway: Softness steadies when o Nanak, the God-conscious being is absorbed in God's meditation.

lines.translation: The God-conscious being is the dust of all.
The God-conscious being knows the nature of the soul.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: braham giaanee kee sabh uoopar miaa ||
lines.translation: The God-conscious being shows kindness to all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਤੇ ਕਛੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਭਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: braham giaanee te kachh buraa na bhiaa ||
lines.translation: No evil comes from the God-conscious being.
The God-conscious being is always impartial.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬਰਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: braham giaanee kee dhirasaT a(n)mrit barasee ||
lines.translation: Nectar rains down from the glance of the God-conscious being.
The God-conscious being is free from entanglements.
The lifestyle of the God-conscious being is spotlessly pure.
Spiritual wisdom is the food of the God-conscious being.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak braham giaanee kaa braham dhiaan ||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the God-conscious being is absorbed in God's meditation. ||3||

structure: The opening movement names the pressure directly: the God-conscious being is the dust of all.
The middle movement deepens the correction by holding the mind inside nectar rains down from the glance of the God-conscious being.
The closing movement leaves a return you can actually keep: o Nanak, the God-conscious being is absorbed in God's meditation.
